chapter: Hippolyte Charles, the bass and other bands
title: Buying a bass on Rampart Street; the Palace Theater and Mama Lou's
summary: He bought a cheap bass on Rampart Street, spent about four years at the Palace Theater in the Dejan band with drummers Pico and Dave Oxley, then played years at Mama Lou's with Andrew Jefferson.
